title: Denormalization and materialized views

kcs.statement: Denormalization copies data into the rows that read it, such as storing author_name on each post, so a hot read needs no join.
Denormalized copies must be updated on every write to the source, so denormalization suits read-heavy workloads and risks copies drifting out of sync.
A materialized view stores the precomputed result of a query and is refreshed on a schedule or on change, trading freshness for read speed.
